```{python}
#| label: fig-modeling-excl
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Two architectures of the exclusive counter. (a) A 3-bit binary counter `cnt_q` and a decoder: few flip-flops, but the outputs come from combinational logic. (b) A one-hot ring of eight flip-flops: each output comes directly from a flip-flop. All flip-flops run on `clk_i` with the reset `rst_ni`. In (b), the multiplexers in front of the D inputs that implement `clr_i` and `en_i` are not drawn."
#| fig-alt: "Two block diagrams. (a) Next-state logic with the inputs clr_i and en_i feeds a register cnt_q of three flip-flops, whose output is fed back to the logic and drives a decoder from 3 to 8 bits with the output q_o of 8 bits. (b) Eight flip-flops in a row, each output feeding the D input of the next one, with the output of the last one fed back to the first. Each flip-flop output is also one bit of q_o, from q_o[0] to q_o[7]."
import schemdraw as sd
from schemdraw import flow
from schemdraw import elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

BLUE, BLUE_L = '#6c8ebf', '#dae8fc'
GREEN, GREEN_L = '#82b366', '#d5e8d4'


def clock_triangle(x, yc):
    flow.Line().at((x, yc + 0.15)).to((x + 0.22, yc)).color('black')
    flow.Line().at((x + 0.22, yc)).to((x, yc - 0.15)).color('black')


def bus_mark(x, y, n):
    ''' Slash with the bus width on a horizontal wire '''
    elm.Line().at((x - 0.12, y - 0.18)).to((x + 0.12, y + 0.18)).color('black').linewidth(1.2)
    elm.Label().at((x, y + 0.32)).label(str(n), fontsize=11, color='black')


with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=1, fontsize=11, lw=1.5, bgcolor='white')

    # (a) binary counter and decoder
    ya = 0.0
    elm.Label().at((-1.2, ya + 2.2)).label('(a) binary counter and decoder', halign='left', color='black')
    nsl = flow.Box(w=2.2, h=1.3).at((1.0, ya)).anchor('center').fill(GREEN_L).color(GREEN) \
        .label('next-state\nlogic (+1)', color='black')
    rx0, rx1 = 3.4, 4.8
    flow.Box(w=rx1 - rx0, h=1.6).at(((rx0 + rx1)/2, ya)).anchor('center').fill(BLUE_L).color(BLUE) \
        .label('cnt_q', loc='center', ofst=(0, 0.35), color='black')
    clock_triangle(rx0, ya - 0.5)
    dec = flow.Box(w=1.8, h=1.3).at((7.3, ya)).anchor('center').fill(GREEN_L).color(GREEN) \
        .label('decoder\n3 to 8', color='black')
    flow.Arrow().at(nsl.E).to((rx0, ya))
    flow.Arrow().at((rx1, ya)).to(dec.W)
    bus_mark(5.3, ya, 3)
    flow.Arrow().at(dec.E).to((10.4, ya))
    elm.Label().at((10.6, ya)).label('q_o', halign='left', color='black')
    bus_mark(9.2, ya, 8)
    xf, yt = 5.95, ya + 1.25
    elm.Dot(radius=0.06).at((xf, ya))
    flow.Line().at((xf, ya)).to((xf, yt))
    flow.Line().at((xf, yt)).to((1.0, yt))
    flow.Arrow().at((1.0, yt)).to(nsl.N)
    flow.Arrow().at((-0.9, ya + 0.3)).to((nsl.W[0], ya + 0.3))
    flow.Arrow().at((-0.9, ya - 0.3)).to((nsl.W[0], ya - 0.3))
    elm.Label().at((-1.0, ya + 0.3)).label('clr_i', halign='right', color='black')
    elm.Label().at((-1.0, ya - 0.3)).label('en_i', halign='right', color='black')

    # (b) one-hot ring of eight flip-flops
    yb = -4.2
    elm.Label().at((-1.2, yb + 2.2)).label('(b) one-hot ring', halign='left', color='black')
    pitch, fw, fh, x0 = 1.6, 0.8, 1.0, -0.6
    ys = yb + 0.2
    for i in range(8):
        x = x0 + i*pitch
        flow.Box(w=fw, h=fh).at((x + fw/2, yb)).anchor('center').fill(BLUE_L).color(BLUE)
        clock_triangle(x, yb - 0.25)
        xt = x + fw + 0.2                         # tap of q_o[i] right of the flip-flop
        if i < 7:
            flow.Line().at((x + fw, ys)).to((xt, ys))
            flow.Arrow().at((xt, ys)).to((x + pitch, ys))
        else:
            flow.Line().at((x + fw, ys)).to((xt, ys))
        elm.Dot(radius=0.06).at((xt, ys)) if i < 7 else None
        flow.Arrow().at((xt, ys)).to((xt, yb - 1.1))
        elm.Label().at((xt, yb - 1.4)).label(f'q_o[{i}]', fontsize=10, color='black')
    # the last output returns to the first input
    xl, yr = x0 + 7*pitch + fw + 0.2, yb + 1.0
    xs = x0 - 0.35
    flow.Line().at((xl, ys)).to((xl, yr))
    flow.Line().at((xl, yr)).to((xs, yr))
    flow.Line().at((xs, yr)).to((xs, ys))
    flow.Arrow().at((xs, ys)).to((x0, ys))
    elm.Dot(radius=0.06).at((xl, ys))
```
